codebook_feedback: The 'AI asked' rule does not say whether 'If you tell me X, I can...' offers count as a question; this decided D2 vs D3 in 66d9e5be and 69fff128, whose messages the codebook itself lists as D3 examples although the AI had just invited more detail. Very short onset statements ('started hurting yesterday', 69600cc8) and vague 'lately' (63e55f08) are not clearly covered by the overall-duration rule. Named conditions that are the main complaint (eczema in 6acb95ac) could be read as health history. Implied questions such as 'I don't know if that means anything' (66d8e4c1) sit between M3 and M1. Whether causes/situations in mental-health chats (stressors in 6a0206ae) are main problem or background is unclear.
